post_ci_fix.cause: The process marker disappears before outer shutdown cleanup releases the service lock. Stop returned early and restart raced the old lock.
post_ci_fix.fix: Wait for the verified process identity to exit even after marker removal; do not send another shutdown signal after the marker disappears. Preserve identity checks, timeout and refusal to force-kill.
